_note: Pre-registered 2026-11-11 (evening), BEFORE the collector for this source was built and before any signal of this source was recorded or any return was seen. Do not edit to fit a result. To change a rule, add a dated entry to docs/research/log.md saying why, then edit.
purpose: Post-earnings drift in the stocks that earnings_reaction_v1 deliberately excludes: smaller, less liquid companies. earnings_reaction_v1 (20-day average dollar volume of at least 5M USD) is expected to be a null, because the literature says drift has largely vanished for large stocks (Martineau 2021/2022, 'Rest in Peace PEAD': no drift for all but microcaps; Zhao 2022) while it may survive where trading is costly and attention is thin (Chordia, Goyal, Sadka, Sadka and Shivakumar 2009). All from search summaries on 2026-11-11, not full papers. This source asks whether the effect survives in the band below, with costs set high enough to be honest about it.
data: Identical to earnings_reaction_v1: the SEC current 8-K Atom feed for item 2.02 filings, SEC company tickers, IBKR daily TRADES bars for the stock and SPY.
event_rule: Identical to earnings_reaction_v1 (same events, same reaction-day rule, same reaction measure R = stock close-to-close move minus SPY's on the reaction day, same 5.0% threshold both ways, same 30-day no-repeat per issuer). The ONLY differences are the liquidity band and the cost.
liquidity_band: At the close of the reaction day: close at least 3.00 USD and 20-day average dollar volume over the 20 sessions before it at least 500,000 USD and BELOW 5,000,000 USD. The two sources therefore never share a stock on the same day: this one takes exactly what earnings_reaction_v1 rejects for volume, minus the thinnest names.
signal_rule: R at least +5.0% gives a long signal (+1); R at most -5.0% gives a short signal (-1); otherwise nothing.
emission: Recorded by the late job after 16:20 ET on the reaction day; event_id is the reaction day (YYYYMMDD); price is the reaction-day close. A missed evening is lost, never recorded late.
timing: Entry is the open of the first trading day strictly after the ledger date.
cost_assumption: round_trip_cost 0.006 (60 bps): about 10 bps commission plus roughly 50 bps of spread and impact for stocks trading 0.5M to 5M USD a day. Short borrow fees are not modelled and many of these names cannot be borrowed.
ledger: horizons 1, 5 and 21 trading days against SPY; primary horizon 21
multiplicity: Ten ledger sources will run at once or soon (insider_cluster_v1, claude_earnings_v1, insider_opportunistic_v1, earnings_reaction_v1, analyst_actions_v1, weekly_reversal_v1, short_volume_v1, this one, and the volatility shadow, plus one spare). This source needs t above 2.9 (a one-sided 5% test split ten ways, Bonferroni, rounded up).

pass_all_of: mean net excess return at 21 days (direction-adjusted) above 1.0% after the 60 bps cost
t-statistic of the 21-day net excess returns above 2.9
positive mean net excess in BOTH chronological halves of the scored signals
LONG signals alone also have a positive mean net excess (a short-only result is not tradable here: borrow is unmodelled and often unavailable)
fewer than 10% of signals unscorable 30 trading days after their horizon
reported_not_criteria: longs and shorts separately, by reaction size (5-10%, above 10%) and by dollar-volume half
events excluded by the band, missing bars and missing tickers (counts)
the comparison with earnings_reaction_v1 on the same days

known_limits: Most events cluster in four seasons, so signals arrive in bursts and are correlated within a day and a season: the t-statistic overstates the evidence. A single season is NOT an independent confirmation; a pass needs a second season (January 2027 or April 2027).
Daily bars only, delayed data: the reaction-day close already holds the first part of any drift.
Wide spreads make the 60 bps assumption uncertain in both directions; paper fills cannot settle it.
Short signals assume the stock can be borrowed; IBKR shortability is not checked.
The band edges (500k, 5M USD) are chosen by me before any result and are not tuned.
if_fail: Report it as a failure and stop spending effort on post-earnings drift in small stocks.
if_pass: Not proof and not real money: a second independent season, a realistic-size execution check (these names move on a 20,000 USD order), then evidence/gate.json.
